# Tejaswini Industries

Tejaswini Industries manufactures distribution transformers, dry-type transformers, HT panels, LT panels and ring main units in Mallapur, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Established 2011.

Distribution transformers are 100 kVA to 2000 kVA at 11 kV, 22 kV and 33 kV, with ONAN (oil-cooled) cooling, off-load or on-load tap changers, a CRGO or amorphous core, and an aluminium or copper winding. Those choices are build options on the distribution transformer page. Each product page opens with a short answer, then question-style sections, a specification table and FAQs, and links to the related guides below. Quotes: send rating, voltage and site location through the contact page. Dry-type units are VPI up to 2000 kVA. The site shows ISO 9001:2015 and BIS Certified marks and says products are IS/IEC compliant. It does not publish certificate numbers, loss wattages, efficiency-star ratings, a lead time, or a TSSPDCL product approval. TGSPDCL / TSSPDCL liaisoning is listed as a service.

Calls and WhatsApp use the same number.
